verdict.rationale: Ramp's Developer API is clearly versioned (paths under /developer/v1/..., OpenAPI spec titled 'Ramp Developer API' v1) and some endpoints carry ad-hoc breaking-change caveats (e.g. banking API note 'may receive breaking changes'), but no evidence pack item documents an explicit, formal deprecation policy (e.g. sunset timelines, versioning guarantees, migration guides) for the API overall. Missing for 10: a published API versioning/deprecation policy document, sunset/EOL timelines for old versions, and migration guidance for breaking changes.
